text:
ana: Quick sync — launching a mini experiment on the Pricing & Packaging page now. Scope: 3 small changes rolled together so we can measure combined lift for demo signups and qualified inbound. Details below. mike_marketing: TL;DR what are the 3 changes? :eyes: ana: 1) Tier name tweak (Business -> Business Pro, Startup -> Startup Basic) to reduce confusion. 2) Move the calculator up under the hero for en-US and en-GB only. 3) Reorder FAQ so 'security & compliance' appears first for enterprise-seeking visitors. sophia_growth: Nice. What's the hypothesis / primary metric? ana: Hypothesis: clearer tier names + earlier calculator will increase demo CTA clicks by >=6% and reduce initial CS triage for pricing questions by 12%. Primary metric = demo_cta_click_rate. Secondary = inbound_quality_tagged (sales-qualified by CS). Window = 72 hours. :rocket: jared_product: Can we split test the tier names independently? If not, make sure we annotate which sessions saw the calculator moved. We need event names. mike_marketing: We'll do 2 buckets: control vs combined-change. GA events: `pricing_page_view`, `pricing_calc_open`, `demo_cta_click`, `pricing_inbound_tag`. Use param `experiment_id=pack-nudge-2026-03` and `variant=control|combo`. mike_marketing: Widget snippet to insert at top of content for calc placement: ```
``` leah_sales: For routing — want leads that click demo CTA and have >10M ARR attribute to go to Dedicated sales queue. Can we add `lead_route=dedicated` when `account_size=large`? sam_ops: Yes. Add the param `route_hint=dedicated` to the webhook payload. Current inbound webhook: `https://hooks.redwood.com/inbound?src=pricing&exp=pack-nudge-2026-03`. We'll add `&route_hint=dedicated` for flagged leads. Also tagging: `tag:pricing-nudge` and `lead_score` passed. leah_sales: Perfect. How will CS see that in Intercom? sam_ops: Intercom mapping already pulls `tags` and `lead_score`. I will add a workflow to auto-assign to `#sales-dedicated` if `route_hint=dedicated`. ETA 2 hours. sophia_growth: Localization note — en-GB copy variation has slightly different currency phrasing. We'll run en-GB only for the calc placement so we can catch UX differences. No other locales touched. jared_product: Quick check: does moving calc affect page speed? Keep an eye on LCP and CLS. If LCP delta > 200ms we rollback. Sam, can you add a health check? sam_ops: Adding a simple synthetic check and Grafana alert: `pricing.lcp.delta > 200ms for 5m` -> roll back experiment. Also will surface errors to #eng-runtime. ana: Copy microcopy for the demo CTA tweak (to align with tier names): `See how Business Pro performs` vs control `Request a demo`. We'll measure which wins. mike_marketing: I'll ship copy A/B within the combo variant: variant-level param `cta_copy=baseline|pro_name`. We can look at interaction by variant param. leah_sales: One ask: tag inbound leads with `pricing_variant=combo` so post-demo followups can reference the new tier names. Happy to draft email snippets if we see lift. inbound-bot: New webhook configured: `/inbound?src=pricing&exp=pack-nudge-2026-03` -> posting to #sales-inbound. Sample payload fields: `email, company, lead_score, tags=[pricing-nudge, pricing_variant:combo], route_hint`. ana: Timing: rolling to 10% traffic now, increase to 50% after 6h if metrics look good. Quick standup at +12h to review preliminary lift. sophia_growth: I'll pull a cohort report at +24h and surface demo_cta conversion by country (US/GB) and by `account_size`. mike_marketing: I'll own the dashboard: `marketing/pricing/pack-nudge-2026-03`. Adding events and segments now. jared_product: Thx — watch performance and feedback. If CS reports a spike in 'where's the old tier' messages, we have an FAQ snippet ready: `Why Business -> Business Pro?` short blurb + rollback plan. ana: ACK. Thanks team — ping here for any issues. :thumbsup: mike_marketing: Quick FYI — I'll post a short rollout note to #marketing-launches with links to dashboard and webhook docs. inbound-bot: Experiment live: pack-nudge-2026-03 (10% traffic). Good luck! :thinking_face:
